cpu_runs.what: READ-ONLY diagnostic telemetry only. clocks.sm relative spread 0.893 with throttle masks [0] throughout -- 89% clock movement with no throttle bit set, which is item 4's distinction demonstrated rather than asserted. 8 tests.

hold_in_force: The MUTATING half (nvidia-smi -lgc/-pl, persistence-mode setup) is HELD PENDING A HUMAN DECISION: it requires root and changes global GPU state shared with cclm, opguard and chessvar. Nothing in this bead invokes it, and a test greps the executable body for those flags.
not_a_measurement: Read-only nvidia-smi --query-gpu is diagnostic, permitted outside the queue by the 2026-09-27 rule amendment, and never citable as a measurement. Every record stamps that statement onto the artifact.
removed_from_my_own_tool: The first draft had --around <command>, which ran a command beside the sampling. Removed: it invites GPU work outside the queue, which the rules forbid and which would contaminate another tenant's measurement.
still_owed: Sampling around an actual QUEUED measurement, and whether throttling is a factor during one. Both need the measurement in the queue; neither is producible by a diagnostic tool beside an idle GPU.
